title: 实际轨迹跟踪与动力学
caption: Actual torque-driven SRS traces at the author-reported point (15.6 s, 0.2686 rad; source-nullspace and adapted HQP) and at the preregistered common-time joint result. Position, rotation and shape errors, world base speed, separate P/H drift about the fixed world origin, actual applied torque and actual joint speed are shown. Curves end at the true stopping time: x marks an unqualified run and a circle a qualified run. Horizontal dotted lines are frozen path gates (5 mm, 1 deg, 2 deg), P/H drift gates (1e-6 kg m/s and 1e-6 kg m²/s), and torque/joint-speed limits (50 N m, 0.8 rad/s). There is no fabricated terminal segment. Plotted failed trajectories do not establish source reproduction. Qualification covers the declared inertial model and gates, not physical collision clearance or contact. Author / source: JOINT_VELOCITY_COMMAND_LIMIT, end=6.120000 s; Author / HQP: ACTUAL_JOINT_VELOCITY_LIMIT, end=7.120000 s; Common / joint: COMPLETED, end=18.451817 s.
